prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Helpful changes: Flow reordering, targeted guidance hints (photo lighting/quality, path helper, account restore/security), single-click and card carousel layouts, hotkey shortcut copy, and interactive waiting status updates reliably yield significant wins.
Harmful changes: Complex setup or placement flow overhauls, intrusive split-view or spotlight layouts, interactive practice flows, pick friend redesigns, and cheat sheet screens lead to performance drops or early terminations.
No effect seen: Dedicated tutorial or environment prep screens, static waiting hints and carousels, background completion notifications, and incentive badges consistently show no clear effect.
Predictions too high: Predictions of +8.0% or higher consistently overestimate actual impact, frequently resulting in no clear effect or severe negative outcomes.
Predictions too low: Shortcut hotkey copy, account security and identity hints, and interactive waiting status updates frequently outperform negative or low initial predictions.

Changes:
0: [sign_in, hint] Existing Account Pet Retention Warning Hint: Display an explicit safety hint on the sign-in screen reassuring returning users that authenticating restores their existing pet profile. (why: The top support theme last week was 'Pets missing or reset after signing in again' with 8 email complaints.)
1: [home, wait_info] Waiting Screen Pet Trait Assembly Progress Update: Add dynamic pet trait assembly updates and progress indicator to the waiting screen during pet rendering. (why: The waiting screen (home step) has a long mean completion time of 2336s. Interactive waiting updates have proven effective at keeping users engaged.)
2: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Quick Control Discovery Screen: Introduce a new dedicated screen right before the final welcome screen explaining desktop pet controls and tray shortcuts. (why: Support received 3 emails specifically asking how to control, hide, or talk to their pet after finishing onboarding.)
3: [choose_path, new_flow] Path Selection Choice Guidance Flow: Implement a card-based path selection flow that highlights clear path choices with structured choice cards. (why: Choose path has a median completion time of 8s but a mean of 514s, indicating significant hesitation for undecided users.)
4: [adoption, hint] Photo Focus and Clarity Guidance Callout: Add a clear guidance hint on the photo upload screen recommending well-lit photos with a single focused subject. (why: Support received 3 emails reporting custom pet generation failures or incorrect visual outputs.)
5: [finish, copy] Desktop Visibility Companion Quick Launch Copy: Update the home intro screen headline and body text to clarify pet screen presence and tray toggle controls. (why: Support received 3 emails where users reported their pet did not show on the desktop after completing setup.)
6: [sign_in, layout] Centered Quick Sign-In Option Layout: Switch sign-in screen layout to a centered card focus emphasizing quick sign-in options. (why: Support logged 2 tickets regarding sign-in stalling or failing to load properly.)
7: [choose_path, layout] Story Screen Card Intro Layout: Update the story intro screen layout to card format with step counter enabled for visual pacing. (why: Improves initial onboarding flow clarity and sets clear progression expectations from the first screen.)
